tool_input.title: Unify Toolbar Element Visual Consistency
tool_input.summary:
Applied another pass to enforce strict toolbar visual consistency using one shared style contract for interactive controls in toolbar zones.

What changed in `elements/ui/globals.css`:
- Unified typography weight across all toolbar interactive items:
  - `[data-slot="toggle-group-item"]`, `[data-slot="button-group-item"]`, and `[data-slot="action"]` now use `font-weight: 500`.
- Removed prior settings-only neutralized `data-state=on` override.
- Added one consistent active-state style for toolbar toggles across toolbar zones:
  - `[data-slot="toolbar-zone"] [data-slot="toggle-group-item"][data-state="on"]` now uses `--active-base` + `--active-foreground`.
  - Matching hover behavior uses color-mix darkening on active base.

Why:
- Latest screenshots showed remaining mismatch in active/inactive visual language between group and settings controls.
- This change removes special-case behavior and enforces one active-state system for toolbar toggles.

Validation:
- `npx tsc --noEmit --project semio/sketchpad/tsconfig.json` passed.
- `npm test --workspace elements/ui` passed (24/24).
- No linter errors on changed file.

event.text:
I kept going and applied another consistency pass.

### What I changed now
In `elements/ui/globals.css` I removed the special-case settings override and replaced it with one unified toolbar contract:

- Unified font weight across all toolbar interactive items:
  - `[data-slot="toggle-group-item"]`
  - `[data-slot="button-group-item"]`
  - `[data-slot="action"]`
  - all now use `font-weight: 500`
- Unified active-state visuals for toolbar toggles everywhere in toolbar zones:
  - `[data-slot="toolbar-zone"] [data-slot="toggle-group-item"][data-state="on"]`
  - uses `--active-base` + `--active-foreground`
  - hover uses a consistent darkened active base (`color-mix`)

This removes the prior special behavior that made settings controls look like a different styling system.

### Validation
- `npx tsc --noEmit --project semio/sketchpad/tsconfig.json` passed
- `npm test --workspace elements/ui` passed (`24/24`)
- no lints in changed file

Share one more screenshot after refresh/HMR; if any mismatch remains, I’ll keep iterating immediately.
